name: trove-test-gap-audit
description: Read-only audit for missing, weak, stale, or mis-scoped test coverage. Audits the whole repository when no scope is named, or one feature, PR, branch, route, service, or risky change when it is. Use when asked what tests are missing, whether coverage is enough, or what regression tests would prove a change safe. This is not a bug hunt and not a security review; use trove-tdd to write the test it recommends.
